title: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
notes: Does not launch on d3dmetal: 'graphics card does not support Shader Model 6.7', D3DMetal caps at SM 6.6. Highball's and CrossOver 26.3's D3DMetal dylibs are byte-identical. With vkd3d-proton 3.1.0 + DXVK 3.1 replacing D3DMetal the SM wall is passable (SM 6.8 measured) on MoltenVK 1.4.1; boots and renders ~55 frames of the loading screen, then hangs in the game's own fiber scheduler. Blockers left: nullDescriptor, robustBufferAccess2, tiled resources tier 2 (hardware). Highball 0.7.14.
